title: 008 - First and Last Label
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print the first and last values as 7-12 and prints exactly `7-12`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def first_and_last_label(score):
    return "PASS" if score > 40 else "FAIL"
solutionCode:
def first_and_last_label(score):
    return "PASS" if score >= 40 else "FAIL"
hint: The program is printing the values in the wrong order.
explanation: The broken code swaps the first and last items. Printing them in the expected order fixes the label.
